main_text.p: progignat. Recipe ergo partem unam plumbi, quod liquefcat in crucibulo super carbonibus accensis, postea cum pyrolabe exime crucibulum, & priusquam plumbum congalefcat immitte tantundem Mercury crudi ac vivi & leniter agita bacillo. Habeas deinde sulphuris communis partem item unam, quod fluat in alio crucibulo, cui fuso injce frustulatim superius malagma coagulatū, ac agito spatula, & cave ne sulphur flammam concipiat aut adauratur, priusquā omnia injeceris. Inde sponte refrigeratum tere super marmore vel saxo & iterum crucibulo impositum fundatur, donec comburatur sulphur, & materia imposita tantisper fluat, ut in virgam effundi possit metallicam, similem Antimonio fuso & friabilem. Hujus triti recipe partem unam & argenti laminati unam & fac stratum super stratum in crucibulo, & desuper minutim pistum vitrum venetum imponatur, ad spissitudinem digiti, nec nimium repleatur vas, ne vitrum

page.notes: Printed text is in italic throughout; the word "exime" and "fuso injce" are as printed in the scan, with doubtful letters. Some words near the binding edge are faint. The running head reads DISQUISTIO as printed.
